ModMetaData.name: RimMandrake: Wasteland
ModMetaData.author: mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
WASTELAND_RM_MOD_BUILD_1 (Phase A row 4 of design/RimMandrake/biome_mod_architecture.md, parent BIOME_MOD_SPLIT_EXECUTION_1). A bone-dry, radiologically-live wasteland biome, generalized: it names no other franchise or campaign and is playable standalone on any generated RimWorld planet. A separate frozen campaign world's own Wasteland instance (RUT_Wasteland, src/RimUtinni) is unaffected and unrelated; this is a new sibling biome for everyone else's worlds, not a rename of that one.
RM tier: nothing here knows what campaign or planet uses it.
Ships:
1. RM_Wasteland, a BiomeDef whose own workerClass (RM_BiomeWorker_Wasteland) is this mod's, never a donor's — a Core+DLC-only wildAnimals/wildPlants roster (the campaign's Star Wars and RUT_-native cast rides a separate Utinni patch, never this def — RimMandrake never names Star Wars). 2. The brine-battery mining archetype: RM_WastelandBrine{Deep,MovingChestDeep, Shallow,MovingShallow} terrain (Odyssey-gated ToxicWater* family), three mineable deposit buildings (tekk/drazz/spent-electrode beds), the RM_Tekk/RM_Drazz/RM_BrinePlate items they yield, RM_BrineShock (the raw-drazz ingestion hediff), and the GenStepDefs + Base_Player registration that scatter the deposits into any RM_WastelandBrineShallow water a generated map carries.
NOT in this mod (out of scope for this build, not deferred sub rosa): the dose/geiger radiological layer, the three storm WeatherDefs (ash, radiation halo, plasma), the family mutator/injection palette, and three FOUNDRY creature items (WASTELAND_EXCRETOR_BEZOAR_1, WASTELAND_RADIOTHERMAL_SOLITARY_1, WASTELAND_BRINE_BATTERY_CREATURE_1) whose already-built creatures ride the campaign's Utinni patch, not this def, per Q12 (RSW_/SW_/RUT_-prefixed and donor bare-name rows never live in the RM_ tier).
Live proof is OWED at publish time — see the item's own verify record.
